order_note: Predecessor and supersedes SQL 147 (applied to production on 2026-11-10, pin retired): SQL 150 replaces SQL 147's only object, the SECURITY DEFINER aws_record_external_disbursement(uuid, uuid, jsonb, text), in place (CREATE OR REPLACE: same identity, owner, attributes and EXECUTE ACL), so the engine refuses SQL 150 (predecessors_applied) unless SQL 147 reads applied, i.e. the function is exactly as SQL 147 left it, and after SQL 150 SQL 147 counts as applied while SQL 150 is (supersedes; no superseded_intended_sha256 is pinned because SQL 147 has no other object). The one change: the amount available is the check amount less this tenant's live splits and Moov send legs on the check; the saved PA fee (check_intake_items.pa_fee_pct / pa_fee_amount) is no longer subtracted or read. Everything else is SQL 147's: the member gate (SQL 90's aws_can_write_tenant(uuid), 42501), the input checks, the check locked FOR UPDATE, the idempotency key, the refusal above what is available (P0001 external_disbursement_exceeds_available) and the two INSERTs. The spec prerequisites are the file's own: the disbursement, check, transfer and stakeholder schema (disbursement_batches with id, tenant_id, check_intake_item_id, created_by, check_amount, available_amount, reserve_held, status, notes, completed_at, approved_at, approved_by and approved_amount_cents; disbursement_splits with id, batch_id, tenant_id, amount, status, method, external_check_number, recipient_name, recipient_type, external_notes, stakeholder_account_id, idempotence_key and settled_at; check_intake_items with id, tenant_id and amount; payment_transfers with tenant_id, check_id, leg_role, status and amount_cents; stakeholder_accounts with id, tenant_id and nickname; check_stakeholders with check_intake_item_id, tenant_id and stakeholder_account_id), SQL 90's aws_can_write_tenant(uuid), auth.uid() and role checksops; a read-only production inspect confirms them. The applying login must reach all six relations as the function's owner past RLS (definer_can_write_relations: the table owner without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, or a superuser or BYPASSRLS). Expected pre-state in both environments: the function as SQL 147 left it (release sql150 v1 with SQL 147's body, derived from SQL 147's bytes: 650ad0d486b5eebdf647e4c25a56c8776ed7a412d8735cfc83aad1d449b959fa). The function must be owned by the applying login (functions_owned_by_login), keep its jsonb result (function_results_match) and hold no EXECUTE grant other than checksops and the owner, which the file keeps, and PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role, which it revokes (function_acl_replaceable). The ACL after the apply is checksops and the owner, as before. The API route that calls it (aws/functions/api/external-disbursement.mjs, record-external-disbursement) is unchanged; the Funds tab's outside-payment form applies the same rule (#1752, src/components/payments/FundsTab.tsx) and reaches each environment only through its own guarded SPA path. No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin. Adds no trigger.

The spec names SQL 147 as predecessor and supersedes it, so the pre-state is the function as SQL 147 left it. The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.

intended_post_state.note: aws_record_external_disbursement(uuid, uuid, jsonb, text), owned by checksops_admin, plpgsql, VOLATILE, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path public, pg_temp, RETURNS jsonb, EXECUTE for checksops and the owner (PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role revoked), as SQL 147 left it, with SQL 150's body: a total above the amount available (the check amount - the tenant's live splits and Moov send legs on the check; the saved PA fee is no longer subtracted) is P0001 external_disbursement_exceeds_available; everything else as SQL 147 (only for a signed-in member of the tenant, 42501 external_disbursement_forbidden; the input checks, 22023 external_disbursement_invalid; the check locked FOR UPDATE and owned by the tenant, P0002 external_disbursement_check_not_found; the same key returns the recorded batch and other payments under it are 23505 external_disbursement_key_reused; one completed disbursement_batches row and one settled external_check disbursement_splits row per payee). No other function, table, column, policy, RLS setting, grant, trigger or row change; no payment_transfers row. The fingerprint is releaseIntendedHash('sql150', file bytes) (scripts/deployment-guard/lib/release-sql-state.mjs): 48d61bb31da60ca6f52d2691e3f3a95de9ce33347725a32e9b95b4939ff1bb13.
